notes.title: Try this brand new Soul Link DEMO during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear players,

We've just released a free demo of Soul Link for the upcoming Steam Next Fest!

The demo consists of 11 levels from 3 chapters to show how the core gameplay works, but it should give you a taste of what the full game is like.  And don't forget to wishlist it if you like the demo.
   
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2057610/

Soul Link is a challenging puzzle game where you use your intelligence to build bridges with falling pieces of various shapes. Reconnect this broken land with Soul Bridges, and make the world whole again!
- The world of Soul Link is a world of physics! Make good use of the pieces, as well as tenon and mortise structures, to create solid bridges that can withstand mighty storms. 
- Embark on a breathtaking adventure through the earth, the sky, and the cosmos. Your bridges will face fierce challenges in a wide variety of landscapes and weather! 
- Use your unique skills wisely to overcome insane challenges such as seesaws, floating platforms, storms, lightning, zero gravity, etc. 
- "Form follows function." Lose yourself in the tranquil serenity of beautifully crafted Soul Bridges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598136/2d28e07a50558263a949e9dfe23239c8382aca11.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy it and feel free to let us know what you think of it, welcome to join our discord: [url=https://discord.gg/uBNhNDPFqt]https://discord.gg/uBNhNDPFqt[/url]

And please don't forget to check the demo builds from our other games:
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indienova/list/98354
